In RAN1#113 [2], virtually all the outstanding issues for CJT-CSI, Doppler-CSI and TDCP were discussed and resolved. The first editor’s draft CRs for Rel-18 were made available and reviewed, with the latest versions in [9],[8],[7] for TS 38.212, TS 38.214 and TS 38.215, respectively. In this contribution, we briefly discuss some corrections/additions to the specification descriptions and suggest text proposals for the relevant TS sections.
